1. (Currently amended) A method of providing advertisements in a traffic message comprising: - obtaining traffic data having a traffic condition of a location description on a road network using a processor; - assessing a location reference code associated with the location description assigned by a traffic message supplier using the processor; - assessing an advertising reference code associated with the location reference code using the processor; - determining whether the advertising reference code is present using the processor; and - generating a traffic message having the location reference code and the advertising reference code when the advertising reference code is present using the processor, wherein the traffic message is generated by the processor and stored on a non-transitory computer-readable medium.
